name: Scenario S: Annual Contract Renewal Reminder
comments: Runs daily at 09:30 AM America/New_York (cron: 30 9 * * *). Fetches all rows from the ActiveClients Google Sheet (env.ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID) and iterates over each client. Calculates days_until_renewal from today to renewal_date and flags send_renewal = true when exactly 30 days remain. A router passes only flagged clients downstream. For each eligible client, calculates annual_price (monthly_fee * 10) and savings (monthly_fee * 2), then calls OpenRouter Claude Sonnet 4-6 to generate a personalized 3-paragraph renewal offer email body. Sends that email to the client via Resend (from 'Brian at CWI AI' using env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS). A second Resend call sends Brian an internal renewal alert. Error handler sends a Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any failure. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Schedule trigger — runs daily at 09:30 AM America/New_York. Cron: 30 9 * * *. No input data — fires the scenario each morning to sweep all active clients for upcoming annual renewals exactly 30 days out.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: Google Sheets HTTP GET — GET /v4/spreadsheets/{ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID}/values/ActiveClients. Returns all rows from the ActiveClients tab as a 2D array in response.data.values. Row 0 is the header row (client_name, client_email, renewal_date, tier, monthly_fee). Auth via Bearer env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN. valueRenderOption=FORMATTED_VALUE so dates are returned as human-readable strings.

Iterator — loops over each data row in 2.data.values, skipping the header (row index 0) via slice(...; 1). Emits one bundle per client row. Expected column order: [0] client_name, [1] client_email, [2] renewal_date, [3] tier, [4] monthly_fee. Downstream modules (4–9) run once per client row.

SetVariable — extracts fields from the iterator bundle (module 3) and computes derived values. Sets: client_name (col 0), client_email (col 1), renewal_date (col 2, raw string), tier (col 3), monthly_fee (col 4). Calculates days_until_renewal as ceiling of dateDifference(parseDate(renewal_date), now, 'days') — positive value means renewal is in the future. Sets send_renewal = true only when days_until_renewal equals exactly 30, else false. Sets run_date (today formatted ET). The Router in module 5 reads 4.send_renewal to decide whether to proceed.

Router — two routes. Route 1 (Send Renewal Offer): passes through when 4.send_renewal == true (exactly 30 days until renewal). Proceeds to modules 6, 7, 8, 9. Route 2 (Skip): matches when 4.send_renewal == false; this branch terminates and the iterator advances to the next client. Only clients whose renewal_date is exactly 30 days away reach the pricing, email, and alert modules.

SetVariable — calculates annual pricing from monthly_fee. Sets annual_price = monthly_fee * 10 (pay for 10 months, get 12 — the annual discount offer). Sets savings = monthly_fee * 2 (the two months the client does not pay under the annual plan). Both values are passed to the Claude prompt in module 7 and surfaced in the client email and internal alert.

parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: OpenRouter HTTP POST — model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6. Prompt: 'Write a warm renewal offer email for [client_name] who is on the [tier] plan at $[monthly_fee]/mo. Their annual renewal is in 30 days. Offer: pay for 10 months and get 12 + setup fee waived (saves them $[savings]). Annual price is $[annual_price]. Mention their results have been great. 3 short paragraphs. Return only the email body.' max_tokens 500, temperature 0.7. Claude response is at 7.data.choices[0].message.content.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: Resend HTTP POST — sends personalized renewal offer email to the client. FROM 'Brian at CWI AI <env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS>'. TO: 4.client_email. Subject: 'Your renewal is coming up — here is a special offer'. HTML body: Claude-generated 3-paragraph email (module 7) followed by a highlighted green callout block showing annual_price ($monthly_fee * 10) and savings ($monthly_fee * 2). Annual price is visually emphasized to make the offer scannable.

metadata.notes: Resend HTTP POST — internal renewal alert to Brian. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. TO env.ADMIN_EMAIL. Subject: 'Renewal email sent to [client_name] — renewal in 30 days — [tier] at $[monthly_fee]/mo'. HTML body includes a styled table with client name, email, plan and monthly fee, renewal date, annual offer price (monthly_fee * 10), savings (monthly_fee * 2), and the date the email was sent. Prompts Brian to follow up if no reply within 5 business days.

metadata.notes: Error Handler — Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any scenario failure. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Subject: '[ERROR] Scenario S Renewal Reminder Failed — [client_name]'. HTML body includes error message, failed module, timestamp (ET), client name, client email, tier, monthly_fee, renewal_date, and days_until_renewal from module 4 to allow manual follow-up. handleErrors: false so this module itself does not recurse on error.

notes.content: Module 1: Schedule trigger — cron 30 9 * * * — fires daily at 09:30 AM America/New_York.

Module 2: Google Sheets HTTP GET — /v4/spreadsheets/{ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID}/values/ActiveClients — returns all rows from the ActiveClients tab. Auth: Bearer env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Columns: client_name, client_email, renewal_date, tier, monthly_fee.

Module 3: Iterator — loops over each data row in 2.data.values (skipping header row via slice). One bundle per client. Expected cols: [0] client_name, [1] client_email, [2] renewal_date, [3] tier, [4] monthly_fee.

Module 4: SetVariable — extracts client_name, client_email, renewal_date, tier, monthly_fee. Calculates days_until_renewal (ceiling of dateDifference from now to renewal_date). Sets send_renewal = true only when days_until_renewal == 30. Sets run_date (today ET).
Module 5: Router — Route 1 (Send Renewal Offer): send_renewal == true → proceeds to modules 6, 7, 8, 9. Route 2 (Skip): send_renewal == false → terminates for that client.
Module 6: SetVariable — calculates annual_price = monthly_fee * 10 (pay 10 months, get 12) and savings = monthly_fee * 2. Both values passed to Claude prompt and internal alert.

Module 7: OpenRouter HTTP POST — anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 — generates a warm 3-paragraph renewal offer email for client_name on the tier plan at monthly_fee/mo. Offers annual_price for 12 months (saves savings). Returns only the email body.

Module 8: Resend HTTP POST — client renewal offer email. FROM 'Brian at CWI AI <env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS>'. TO: client email. Subject: 'Your renewal is coming up — here is a special offer'. HTML: Claude-generated email body + highlighted annual price callout block.

Module 9: Resend HTTP POST — internal renewal alert to Brian. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. TO env.ADMIN_EMAIL. Subject: 'Renewal email sent to [client_name] — renewal in 30 days — [tier] at $[monthly_fee]/mo'. HTML table with full client and offer details.

Module 10: Error Handler — Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any failure. Includes error message, failed module, timestamp ET, client name, email, tier, monthly_fee, renewal_date, days_until_renewal for manual follow-up.

environment_variables.ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID for the ActiveClients workbook
environment_variables.GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN: OAuth 2.0 access token (or service account token) with read access to the ActiveClients Google Sheet
environment_variables.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: OpenRouter API key for Claude access
environment_variables.OPENROUTER_REFERRER: HTTP-Referer header value for OpenRouter requests (e.g. https://cwiai.net)
environment_variables.RESEND_API_KEY: Resend API key for sending emails
environment_variables.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS: Verified sender address used as FROM for both client renewal emails (as 'Brian at CWI AI') and internal alerts (e.g. brian@cwiai.net or alerts@cwiai.net)
environment_variables.ADMIN_EMAIL: Brian's email address for internal renewal alerts and error notifications
